user.title: Connect an SDM630
user.description: How is the meter connected to Home Assistant?

data_description.serial_port: Pick the USB/RS485 adapter or type a path. /dev/serial/by-id/... paths keep working when adapters are re-plugged.
data_description.slave_id: Set on the meter (default 1). Every meter on one bus needs its own address.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.slave_id: Address of the meter behind the gateway (default 1).
data_description.framer: Modbus TCP for real Modbus TCP gateways. Choose RTU over TCP for RS485-to-Ethernet converters in transparent mode (common on cheap converters).

reconfigure_serial.title: Change serial (RS485) connection

data_description.serial_port: Pick the USB/RS485 adapter or type a path. /dev/serial/by-id/... paths keep working when adapters are re-plugged.
data_description.slave_id: Set on the meter (default 1). Every meter on one bus needs its own address.

reconfigure_serial.description: The connection is tested before it is saved. Sensors and history are kept.

reconfigure_tcp.title: Change modbus TCP connection

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.slave_id: Address of the meter behind the gateway (default 1).
data_description.framer: Modbus TCP for real Modbus TCP gateways. Choose RTU over TCP for RS485-to-Ethernet converters in transparent mode (common on cheap converters).

reconfigure_tcp.description: The connection is tested before it is saved. Sensors and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the connection. Check the port or host and that nothing else is using it.
error.read_error: Connected, but the meter did not answer correctly. Check the Modbus address and the serial settings (baud rate, parity).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This meter (same connection and Modbus address) is already set up.

data_description.invert_power: Flip the sign of the phase and total power readings. Use this when the meter shows negative power while drawing power, e.g. because the in/out wires or clamps are reversed.
data_description.swap_import_export: Report the meter's export counters as import and vice versa (active and reactive). Note: the counter values jump when you change this, which Home Assistant's long-term statistics will record.
data_description.max_registers: Values close together are fetched in one request (fewer requests, faster polling). Lower this if your gateway struggles with long reads; 4 matches the behaviour of version 0.3.4 and earlier.
